blocks.text: You can edit or delete any cloud alert rule or IaC alert rule you've configured.

blocks.item: On the Alerts page, select the Notifications tab.

blocks.text: The list of all the alert rules is displayed.

blocks.item: Click the Edit icon for the alert rule that you want to edit.
On the Edit Alert Rule page, change the Alert Rule Name or Alert Rule Status as required, then click Next.
Update the details on the Resource Scope page as required, then click Next.
Update the details on the Notifications page as required, then click Next.
Review the changes. Click the Edit icon if you want to change any value again.

blocks.text: A message appears indicating that the alert rule has been updated successfully.

blocks.item: On the Alerts page, select the Notifications tab.

blocks.text: The list of all alert rules configured is displayed.

blocks.item: Click the Delete icon for the alert rule that you want to delete.
A confirmation message appears. Read the message, then click Delete.

blocks.text: A message appears indicating that the alert rule has been deleted successfully.
